pages.quiz:
HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — MOCK EXAM #20
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 90 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 80
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Why is water needed by all living things? (1 mark)
   A. It hides the sun
   B. Life cannot continue without it
   C. It is always warm
   D. It makes things noisy

2. Which tree is linked with Guru Nanak Dev Ji at Sultanpur Lodhi? (1 mark)
   A. Ber (Beri) tree
   B. Bodhi tree
   C. Sal tree
   D. Tulsi

3. What does maha mean in Mahabhoot? (1 mark)
   A. Small
   B. Great
   C. Old
   D. New

4. In a maize farm, what does the sun's heat that ripens the crop represent among the elements? (1 mark)
   A. Jal
   B. Agni
   C. Akash
   D. Prithvi

5. What does Lord Narsimha look like? (1 mark)
   A. A bird
   B. A snake
   C. A fish
   D. A man's body with a lion's head and claws

6. What does the word Guru mean? (1 mark)
   A. A river
   B. A teacher who leads from darkness to light
   C. A festival
   D. A soldier

7. Which is a main message of Jain scriptures? (1 mark)
   A. Take revenge
   B. Practise Ahimsa
   C. Practise pride
   D. Be greedy

8. Who gave the Sigalovada Sutta talk? (1 mark)
   A. The Buddha
   B. Mahavir
   C. Guru Arjan Dev
   D. Valmiki

9. What do Sikhs eat together in the gurdwara? (1 mark)
   A. Nothing
   B. Langar, the community meal
   C. Fasting food
   D. Prasad only from a priest

10. How many directions (groups of people) does the Sigalovada Sutta list? (1 mark)
   A. Two
   B. Four
   C. Nine
   D. Six

11. Who asked that Bharat be made king? (1 mark)
   A. Sita
   B. Queen Kaikeyi
   C. Mahaprajapati
   D. Ganga

12. What is the main idea of the Saraswati Vandana? (1 mark)
   A. To ask for food
   B. To ask for money
   C. To ask for rain
   D. To ask for knowledge and remove ignorance

13. Which is the first line of the Gayatri Mantra? (1 mark)
   A. Ya Kundendu Tushara
   B. Om Bhur Bhuvah Svah
   C. Twameva Mata cha Pita Twameva
   D. Om Namah Shivaya

14. Which is a typical feature of Mandirs? (1 mark)
   A. A kitchen garden
   B. A roaring engine
   C. A bell rung gently on arrival
   D. A water tank

15. Who should you give up your seat to? (1 mark)
   A. The loudest passenger
   B. A friend
   C. Nobody
   D. An elderly person or a pregnant woman

16. What should be written when an item is put in the lost and found? (1 mark)
   A. The price
   B. Nothing
   C. The date and the finder's name
   D. A secret code

17. How should learners who return lost items be treated? (1 mark)
   A. They should be punished
   B. They should be laughed at
   C. They should be ignored
   D. They should be thanked

18. How can children with special needs take part? (1 mark)
   A. Only by watching
   B. By leaving
   C. They cannot join
   D. In their own way, such as breathing slowly or seated poses

19. In Bhastrika, how is the breath done? (1 mark)
   A. In and out with equal strength
   B. Only out
   C. Only in
   D. Not at all

20. How many Purusharthas are there? (1 mark)
   A. Five
   B. Four
   C. Ten
   D. Two

21. Which principle is being followed by greeting parents with Namaste and saying a morning prayer? (1 mark)
   A. Kama only
   B. Punarjanam only
   C. Artha only
   D. Prarthana and respect for Paramatma

22. What does atma mean? (1 mark)
   A. Soul
   B. Water
   C. Body
   D. Fire

23. What does Maha Shivratri teach? (1 mark)
   A. Playing games all night
   B. Self-control, faith and staying alert to do good
   C. Winning arguments
   D. Getting rich

24. Which Jain scripture is often read during Paryushan? (1 mark)
   A. Guru Granth Sahib
   B. Kalpasutra
   C. Ramayan
   D. Dhammapada

25. What is the first line of the Kenyan National Anthem? (1 mark)
   A. Ee Mungu nguvu yetu
   B. Twameva mata cha pita twameva
   C. Om Bhur Bhuvah Svah
   D. Ya Kundendu Tushara

26. Which leaves are offered to Shiva on Maha Shivratri? (1 mark)
   A. Tulsi leaves only
   B. Bel (bilva) leaves
   C. Tea leaves
   D. Banana leaves

27. Which is a safety rule for festivals? (1 mark)
   A. Eat from the ground
   B. Ask an adult to light lamps
   C. Play with fire
   D. Run in the temple

28. Which is the last month listed in the lesson? (1 mark)
   A. Magha
   B. Phalguna
   C. Chaitra
   D. Ashadha

29. What does graha mean in this tradition? (1 mark)
   A. A festival
   B. A heavenly body
   C. A river
   D. A house

30. How many months are in the Indian traditional calendar year? (1 mark)
   A. Twelve
   B. Ten
   C. Seven
   D. Fifteen

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
31. Describe how to set up a lost and found corner in a classroom. (4 marks)

32. Explain what Hindus mean by an Avtar. (2 marks)

33. What is the essence of a scripture? (2 marks)

34. Why should we respect others who have different beliefs about death? (3 marks)

35. Write three ways in which a child can practise Prani Daya. (3 marks)

36. Write a weekly plan using English and Indian day names with one activity for each of three days. (5 marks)

37. Compare the teachings of Parshvanath and Guru Ram Das Ji. (5 marks)

38. Describe how to sit in Vajra Asana. (3 marks)

39. Why should we breathe slowly during asanas? (2 marks)

40. On which date is Madaraka Day and what does Madaraka mean? (2 marks)

41. Explain how to say the Gayatri Mantra correctly. (3 marks)

42. Describe three rites and rituals in a Mandir. (3 marks)

43. Describe how Paryushan Parva is celebrated. (3 marks)

44. Describe the lessons of the Uttaradhyayan Sutra. (4 marks)

45. State what the Gayatri Mantra asks God to give us. (2 marks)

46. Explain why yoga should be practised with an expert. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — MOCK EXAM #20 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. B — Life cannot continue without it
   People, animals and plants all need water to live.

2. A — Ber (Beri) tree
   The Ber Sahib stands beside a gurdwara in Sultanpur Lodhi.

3. B — Great
   Maha means great and bhoot means element.

4. B — Agni
   Heat and light belong to Agni.

5. D — A man's body with a lion's head and claws
   He is shown as a man-lion.

6. B — A teacher who leads from darkness to light
   A guru is a teacher and guide.

7. B — Practise Ahimsa
   Ahimsa is central in Jainism.

8. A — The Buddha
   The Buddha spoke to a young man named Sigala.

9. B — Langar, the community meal
   Everyone eats together in the langar.

10. D — Six
   It lists six groups.

11. B — Queen Kaikeyi
   Kaikeyi reminded the king of two promises.

12. D — To ask for knowledge and remove ignorance
   It asks for a clear mind.

13. B — Om Bhur Bhuvah Svah
   The Gayatri Mantra begins Om Bhur Bhuvah Svah.

14. C — A bell rung gently on arrival
   The bell announces arrival.

15. D — An elderly person or a pregnant woman
   Helping those who need seats shows kindness.

16. C — The date and the finder's name
   The book keeps a record.

17. D — They should be thanked
   Thanking encourages honesty.

18. D — In their own way, such as breathing slowly or seated poses
   Everyone can take part.

19. A — In and out with equal strength
   Breathing is equal, like a bellows.

20. B — Four
   There are four.

21. D — Prarthana and respect for Paramatma
   Prayer and respect for God.

22. A — Soul
   Atma is the soul.

23. B — Self-control, faith and staying alert to do good
   These are its lessons.

24. B — Kalpasutra
   Many Jains hear the Kalpasutra.

25. A — Ee Mungu nguvu yetu
   The anthem is Ee Mungu Nguvu Yetu.

26. B — Bel (bilva) leaves
   Bel leaves are offered.

27. B — Ask an adult to light lamps
   Adults should handle flames.

28. B — Phalguna
   Phalguna is twelfth.

29. B — A heavenly body
   Graha is a heavenly body.

30. A — Twelve
   It has twelve months.

SECTION B
----
31. (4 marks)
   Answer: Place a box or table in a safe place, write each item in a book with the date and finder's name, let owners claim their things, and thank those who return items.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each for four points.

32. (2 marks)
   Answer: A form in which God is believed to come to earth to protect goodness.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for God coming to earth and 1 mark for protecting goodness.

33. (2 marks)
   Answer: The most important message or lesson in it.
   Working / marking points: 2 marks for a correct meaning.

34. (3 marks)
   Answer: People hold different views, listening with respect keeps peace, and arguing does not help.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each.

35. (3 marks)
   Answer: Give water to thirsty animals, share food, help a hurt friend, do not harm insects, care for plants (any three).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each.

36. (5 marks)
   Answer: Any correct plan, for example Somvaar: help at home; Guruvaar: thank a teacher; Shukravaar: share with a friend.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the format and 1 mark each for three correct day names with activities.

37. (5 marks)
   Answer: Parshvanath taught Ahimsa, truth, not taking what is not given and not being greedy. Guru Ram Das Ji taught equality, honest work, humility and service. Both teach kindness and care for others.
   Working / marking points: 2 marks for each teaching set and 1 mark for a comparison.

38. (3 marks)
   Answer: Kneel with knees together, bring big toes close, sit back on your heels, keep the back and head straight and place palms on the thighs.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each for three correct steps.

39. (2 marks)
   Answer: It keeps us calm and helps the body relax.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each.

40. (2 marks)
   Answer: 1 June; power or authority to govern.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each.

41. (3 marks)
   Answer: Sit quietly with a straight back, close eyes and breathe slowly, say it one line at a time and listen first to a teacher or recording so you copy the sounds.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each for three points.

42. (3 marks)
   Answer: Darshan, aarti, prasad, bhajans, ringing the bell (any three, with a short description).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each.

43. (3 marks)
   Answer: Jains fast, pray and meditate, listen to scriptures such as the Kalpasutra, practise Ahimsa, give to the needy and ask for forgiveness.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct practice, up to 3.

44. (4 marks)
   Answer: Practise Ahimsa, be honest, control greed and anger, and respect teachers (any four).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

45. (2 marks)
   Answer: That the divine light guide our minds toward what is good and true (wisdom).
   Working / marking points: 2 marks for wisdom or guidance of the mind.

46. (4 marks)
   Answer: An expert shows the correct posture, corrects mistakes, prevents strain of the back or knees, and knows when to stop.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each for four points.
